name: Haryana Leather Chemicals Limited
about: Haryana Leather Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells various performance chemicals for use in leather processing, footwear finishing, textile printing, pressure sensitive adhesives, and PVC additives in India and internationally. It offers syntans, such as replacement, multi-functional, filling protein, vegetable tannage-functional blends, penetrating bleaching pre-tanning, and dispersing neutralizing syntans; and acrylic retanning emulsions and fat liquors, such as soft and light weight, conventional, waterproofing, and automotive fat liquors. The company also provides acrylic resins and binders, polyurethane and protein binders, polyurethane topcoats, compacts, lacquers, fillers and waxes, touch modifiers, correction agents for defects, pull-up oils and auxiliaries, penetrators and levelling agents, cationic finishes, pigments and dye solutions, and specialty finishes. The company also provides emulsifiers, degreasers, and cationic fats; and textile binders, such as polyurethane and acrylic emulsions. Additionally, it offers footwear finishes, including brushable creams, self-polishing creams, feel modifier, solid waxes, burnish wax bar, wax based aqueous dressings, resin and NC based dressings, adhesion promoters, revivers, pull up oils and crazy finishes, rectification oils and resins, water repelling agent, coloring dyes, repairerspigments, detergents and cleaners, and special products. Haryana Leather Chemicals Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Gurugram, India.
